SANDHYA CHOMATILL KUMAR PROJECT DELIVERY & CUSTOMER SUCCESS MANAGER | FINTECH | PAYMENTS | API & PARTNER INTEGRATIONS

Bengaluru, India | +91 9886688112 | sandhyagowdack9@gmail.com | LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/sandhya-gowda/

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY Results-driven Program Delivery and Customer Success Manager with 12+ years of experience across FinTech, payments, and financial services, specializing in end-to-end program management, cross-border payment integrations, API integrations, partner onboarding, and enterprise stakeholder management. Proven track record of delivering 150+ cross-border payment integration projects and leading a complex 2.5-year Visa integration program, driving partner connectivity and expansion of global payment capabilities. Experienced in cross-functional leadership across Product, Engineering, Compliance, Finance, Treasury, Operations, Sales, and Customer Success, with strong expertise in program governance, RAID management, risk mitigation, regulatory compliance, UAT, and production deployment. Recognized with Best Performance Awards in Q3 2023 and Q3 2024 for exceptional program delivery and leadership.

CORE COMPETENCIES & TECHNICAL SKILLS Program & Project Management: Program Management | Project Delivery | Project Lifecycle Management | Program Governance | RAID Management | KPI Tracking | Risk & Issue Management | UAT Coordination | Production Deployment

Payments & FinTech: Cross-Border Payments | Payment Gateway Integration | API Integrations | SWIFT | ISO 20022 | FinTech Operations

Partner & Customer Management: Partner Integrations | Partner Onboarding | Customer Success | Enterprise Client Management | Stakeholder Management | Client Relationship Management | Cross-Functional Leadership

Regulatory Compliance: Regulatory Compliance | AML | KYC | FEMA | RBI Guidelines

Tools: Jira | Microsoft Project | Microsoft Excel

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE TerraPay Solutions | Bengaluru | Project Delivery & Program Manager – Partner Integrations & Customer Success | 06/2021 – Present



Lead end-to-end program delivery and API integration initiatives for complex FinTech and cross-border payment solutions, driving implementation from planning and partner onboarding through UAT, production deployment, and post-go-live support.

Delivered 150+ cross-border payment integration projects, enabling seamless partner connectivity and



contributing to the expansion of TerraPay’s global payment network and market reach. Led a complex 2.5-year strategic Visa integration program, coordinating cross-functional stakeholders to enhance core payment infrastructure and expand global transaction capabilities.

Drive cross-functional program execution across Product, Engineering, Compliance, Treasury, Finance, Operations, Sales, and Customer Success, ensuring alignment of technical, operational, regulatory, and business objectives.

Own program governance and stakeholder management, including RAID management, KPI tracking, risk and issue mitigation, status reporting, dependency management, and proactive escalation to maintain delivery momentum.

Manage international partner integrations across multiple markets, including Unimoni (Oman),



Almuzhaini Exchange (Kuwait), Moorwand, Neema, and PrivatBank (Europe), supporting complex payment connectivity and implementation requirements. Lead enterprise customer success and partner relationships across the payments ecosystem, ensuring successful integration outcomes, resolving delivery challenges, and strengthening long-term partner engagement.

• Recognized with Best Performance Awards in Q3 2023 and Q3 2024 for exceptional program delivery,

execution, and leadership.

Thomas Cook India Ltd | Bengaluru | Manager | 07/2010 – 06/2021

Managed branch operations and foreign exchange (forex) services, driving operational efficiency, service



quality, and customer satisfaction across day-to-day financial operations. Led regulatory compliance across AML, KYC, FEMA, and RBI guidelines, ensuring adherence to statutory requirements and strengthening operational controls.

Managed banking partner onboarding initiatives, establishing and maintaining strategic partnerships to expand the organization’s financial services network and capabilities.

Built and managed enterprise client relationships with prominent organizations including Philips, Alcatel Lucent, NXP, ANZ, TP Vision, Flipkart, Genpact, and Nvidia, ensuring their financial and service requirements were effectively addressed.

Strengthened client relationship management and stakeholder engagement, developing trusted relationships with enterprise customers and financial partners.

Maintained a strong compliance and risk management track record, supporting regulatory adherence, operational integrity, and protection of the organization’s reputation.

Recognized as Best Performer of the Year 2020 for exceptional contributions to compliance management and client relationship development.

SELECTED ACHIEVEMENTS & IMPACT

150+ cross-border payment integration projects delivered, demonstrating high-volume program execution and partner connectivity expertise.

2.5-year strategic Visa integration program led from implementation through payment infrastructure enhancement.

Best Performance Awards – Q3 2023 & Q3 2024 at TerraPay for program delivery and leadership. • Best Performer of the Year 2020 at Thomas Cook India for compliance management and client relationship development.

Delivered international partner integrations across Oman, Kuwait and Europe, supporting global payments expansion.

CERTIFICATIONS

PSPO I – Professional Scrum Product Owner I • FinTech Risk Management • Automate Tasks and Processes with Jira • Project Management Tracker Using Microsoft Excel • Project Management Professional (PMP) – In Progress

EDUCATION Bachelor’s Degree| Dr. C. V. Raman University, Bengaluru | 01/2012 – 01/2014

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE TerraPay Solutions | Bengaluru | Project Delivery & Program Manager – Partner Integrations & Customer Success | 06/2021 – Present

Lead end-to-end program delivery and API integration initiatives for complex FinTech and cross-border payment solutions, driving implementation from planning and partner onboarding through UAT, production deployment, and post-go-live support.
Delivered 150+ cross-border payment integration projects, enabling seamless partner connectivity and

contributing to the expansion of TerraPay’s global payment network and market reach. Led a complex 2.5-year strategic Visa integration program, coordinating cross-functional stakeholders to enhance core payment infrastructure and expand global transaction capabilities.
Drive cross-functional program execution across Product, Engineering, Compliance, Treasury, Finance, Operations, Sales, and Customer Success, ensuring alignment of technical, operational, regulatory, and business objectives.
Own program governance and stakeholder management, including RAID management, KPI tracking, risk and issue mitigation, status reporting, dependency management, and proactive escalation to maintain delivery momentum.
Manage international partner integrations across multiple markets, including Unimoni (Oman),

Almuzhaini Exchange (Kuwait), Moorwand, Neema, and PrivatBank (Europe), supporting complex payment connectivity and implementation requirements. Lead enterprise customer success and partner relationships across the payments ecosystem, ensuring successful integration outcomes, resolving delivery challenges, and strengthening long-term partner engagement.
• Recognized with Best Performance Awards in Q3 2023 and Q3 2024 for exceptional program delivery,
execution, and leadership.
Thomas Cook India Ltd | Bengaluru | Manager | 07/2010 – 06/2021
Managed branch operations and foreign exchange (forex) services, driving operational efficiency, service

quality, and customer satisfaction across day-to-day financial operations. Led regulatory compliance across AML, KYC, FEMA, and RBI guidelines, ensuring adherence to statutory requirements and strengthening operational controls.
Managed banking partner onboarding initiatives, establishing and maintaining strategic partnerships to expand the organization’s financial services network and capabilities.
Built and managed enterprise client relationships with prominent organizations including Philips, Alcatel Lucent, NXP, ANZ, TP Vision, Flipkart, Genpact, and Nvidia, ensuring their financial and service requirements were effectively addressed.
Strengthened client relationship management and stakeholder engagement, developing trusted relationships with enterprise customers and financial partners.
Maintained a strong compliance and risk management track record, supporting regulatory adherence, operational integrity, and protection of the organization’s reputation.
Recognized as Best Performer of the Year 2020 for exceptional contributions to compliance management and client relationship development.
